<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex042012026-09-0204-02-33" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3864">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">'jad</rs></note> <note type="editorial">Tentative identification as 'Jad byang chub skyabs (ID:3864)</note> na re bstan bcos la gnyis las | mtshan nyid pa dang | brtags pa' ba'o || mtshan nyid pa ni rtog pa dang <lb n="25a6"/> bcas pa'i yid kyi rnam shes gsung cha sgra spyi yi ge 'brel ba dang 'dris par shan pa ste | ma 'brel ba dang ma 'dris pa ni ma yin no || 
				de ltar yang <rs type="work">dbus mtha'</rs> las | <quote><lg><l>'brel ba'i phyir dang 'dres pa'i phyir ||</l> <l>ma 'brel phyir dang ma 'dris phyir ||</l> <l>don yod pa dang myed pa ste ||</l> <l>de ni yi ge ma log pa'o</l></lg></quote> zhes gsungs pa bzhin no || 
				brtags pa ba ni ngag du lung ba'i sgra <lb n="25a7"/> rang gi mtshan nyid dang sho'u la yi ger bkod pa'o zhes la | 
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3834">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">rgya</rs></note> <note type="editorial">Tentative identification as rGya dmar ba Byang chub grags (ID:3834)</note> bstan bcos kyi ngo bo ni chos bzhi dang ldan pa ste | sgra'i spyi yin pa | 'brel pa | 'dris pa | don cig la 'du ba'o zhes so || </seg></TEI>
